applies_to: Consumer reports used in insurance underwriting
plain_english_rule: If consumer-report data is used for underwriting or screening high-risk applicants, FCRA compliance and adverse-action notice controls may apply.
Safeguard customer information and maintain privacy/security controls around nonpublic personal information.
Homeowners insurance practices can raise fair housing concerns if they discriminate in housing-related insurance access.
Insurers using AI should maintain governance, documentation, controls, monitoring, and unfair-discrimination risk management.
Do not use AI/external consumer data in underwriting or pricing unless a comprehensive assessment shows the guidelines are not unfairly or unlawfully discriminatory.

applies_to: External consumer data algorithms predictive models
plain_english_rule: External consumer data, algorithms, or predictive models cannot be used in insurance practices in a way that unfairly discriminates based on protected classes.

applies_to: AI big data and proxy discrimination
plain_english_rule: California flagged AI/big-data use, including social media, internet use, device data, biometric data, and photograph-based predictions, as potential proxy-discrimination and actuarial-nexus concerns.
An insurer may not refuse to underwrite, cancel, or refuse to renew homeowners insurance based wholly or partly on credit history.
